item.title: Trump accepts White House Correspondents' Association dinner invitation for the first time as president
item.description: President Donald Trump announced on Truth Social that he will be attending the White House Correspondents' Association dinner this year after years of skipping it.

item.title: Trump sends official notification to Congress on strikes against Iran
item.description: President Donald Trump on Monday sent an official notification to Congress about the U.S. strikes against Iran, in which he attempted to justify the military action.

item.title: Radiohead blasts ICE for using their song in video mourning victims of migrant crime, demands it be taken down
item.description: Radiohead demands ICE remove pro-Trump video featuring their song "Let Down" that commemorates victims of alleged illegal immigrant violence, calling agency officials "amateurs."

item.title: Iranian drone strikes shut down Qatar LNG production facilities, as energy prices surge
item.description: Drone attacks from Iran target Qatar's energy infrastructure and Saudi Arabia's Ras Tanura refinery, jolting global markets in largest surge since 2022 Ukraine crisis.

item.title: Cher's son arrested twice in one weekend on burglary and assault charges in New Hampshire
item.description: Cher's son Elijah Blue Allman was arrested twice in one weekend in New Hampshire, facing burglary and assault charges after alleged incidents at local properties.

item.title: Iran nuclear talks 'didn't pass the smell test' before Trump launched strikes, says Vance
item.description: Vice President JD Vance said U.S. envoys conducted three rounds of talks with Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi in Geneva, but negotiations failed.

item.title: NBA player calls for Hawks to cancel their 'Magic City' strip club promotional night out of respect for women
item.description: NBA player Luke Kornet criticized the Atlanta Hawks' "Magic City Night" promotion, calling the strip club tribute disrespectful to women in an open letter.

item.title: Netanyahu insists US and Israel's strikes on Iran won't lead to 'endless war'
item.description: In an exclusive interview with Fox News' Sean Hannity, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu insisted the U.S. and Israel's strikes against Iran will not lead to an "endless war."

item.title: Supreme Court blocks California ban on notifying students' parents about gender transitions
item.description: The Supreme Court granted an emergency appeal blocking a California law that banned schools from notifying parents about students' gender identity changes.

item.title: Iranian women's soccer team refuse to sing national anthem in silent protest at Asian Cup
item.description: The Iranian women's soccer team refused to sing the national anthem during their Women's Asian Cup opener against South Korea on the Gold Coast on Monday night.
